boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Samford University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Birmingham-area food destinations with currently posted late hours.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Palisades Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 381 Palisades Blvd, Birmingham, AL 35209
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when you need a late food option; confirm the posted schedule before leaving, especially on holidays.
cards.short_summary: A Birmingham Taco Bell with drive-thru service listed into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists drive-thru hours until 3 AM Sunday–Thursday and 4 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed until 3 AM Sunday–Thursday and 4 AM Friday–Saturday; dine-in hours end earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell in Homewood
cards.subtitle: 159 State Farm Parkway, Homewood, AL 35209
cards.notes: Plan this as a drive-thru stop after evening plans; check the official page for any holiday-hour changes before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A nearby Homewood Taco Bell whose drive-thru runs later than its dining room.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists drive-thru hours until 2 AM Sunday–Thursday and 4 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 159 State Farm Parkway, Homewood
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed until 2 AM Sunday–Thursday and 4 AM Friday–Saturday; dine-in hours end earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on 7th Avenue South
cards.subtitle: 2124 7th Ave S, Birmingham, AL 35233
cards.notes: Treat this as a late drive-thru destination near UAB; use the official hours page to verify the night you plan to go.
cards.short_summary: A Southside Taco Bell with posted drive-thru service into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists drive-thru hours until 3 AM on Sunday–Tuesday and 4 AM Wednesday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed until 3 AM Sunday–Tuesday and 4 AM Wednesday–Saturday; dine-in hours end earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Highway 280
cards.subtitle: 4623 Highway 280 S, Birmingham, AL 35242
cards.notes: Check the live location listing before starting the trip, then use the drive-thru for a late food stop along Highway 280.
cards.short_summary: A Highway 280 Taco Bell listed as open late with drive-thru service.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official Birmingham location directory identifies the 4623 Highway 280 S location as open late and lists it open until 3 AM.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurants in Birmingham, Alabama
cards.access_notes: The official directory lists this location as open until 3 AM; check its individual location page for the day’s schedule.

cards.title: Wendy’s on Valley Avenue
cards.subtitle: 345 Valley Ave, Birmingham, AL 35209
cards.notes: Use this Valley Avenue location for a midnight food stop; its posted restaurant and drive-thru schedules both run to midnight.
cards.short_summary: A Valley Avenue Wendy’s with both service formats listed through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 6:30 AM–12 AM daily.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are listed open until 12 AM daily; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Wendy’s on 7th Avenue South
cards.subtitle: 2327 7th Ave S, Birmingham, AL 35233
cards.notes: Check the posted night-specific hours before leaving; both dining and drive-thru remain available after midnight on the official schedule.
cards.short_summary: A Southside Wendy’s with weekday service listed until 1 AM and weekend service until 2 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists restaurant and drive-thru hours until 1 AM Sunday–Thursday and 2 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are listed until 1 AM Sunday–Thursday and 2 AM Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: McDonald’s on 5th Avenue South
cards.subtitle: 1501 5th Ave S, Birmingham, AL 35203
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for the latest access at this Southside location; the dining room has an earlier listed closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Birmingham McDonald’s with a 24-hour drive-thru schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists its drive-thru as open 24 hours daily, while the lobby is listed until midnight.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed open 24 hours daily; lobby is listed 5 AM–12 AM daily.

cards.title: McDonald’s on Forestdale Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 1309 Forestdale Blvd, Birmingham, AL 35214
cards.notes: For a late drive-thru option, check the day-specific schedule first; its overnight availability is posted for Thursday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Birmingham McDonald’s with 24-hour drive-thru service on selected nights.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists 24-hour drive-thru service Thursday through Saturday and 11 PM closing Monday–Wednesday and Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed open 24 hours Thursday–Saturday; it is listed until 11 PM Monday–Wednesday and Sunday.

cards.title: Whataburger at Highway 280 and Resource Center
cards.subtitle: 111 Resource Center Pkwy, Birmingham, AL 35242
cards.notes: Use the official locator to confirm holiday operations, then choose curbside, delivery, or an on-site food order at this 24-hour location.
cards.short_summary: A Highway 280 Whataburger listed open around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: Whataburger’s official Birmingham location directory lists Whataburger #1116 at 111 Resource Center Parkway as open 24 hours every day.
cards.access_notes: Listed open 24 hours daily; the official page notes holiday hours may differ.

cards.title: Rally’s on First Avenue North
cards.subtitle: 4030 First Avenue N, Birmingham, AL 35212
cards.notes: Make this a late food stop rather than a sit-down plan; verify the night’s schedule and use the official ordering options if needed.
cards.short_summary: A First Avenue North Rally’s with service listed until 2 AM most nights and 3 AM on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists hours until 2 AM Sunday–Thursday and 3 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Listed open until 2 AM Sunday–Thursday and 3 AM Friday–Saturday.
